scope: Paper proofs and exact finite instruments; no scholarly priority, formal-kernel verification, physical observation, RH or normality claim.
independence: Same-model agents and inherited source identities are not independent empirical witnesses; separate implementations and decompositions are enumerated in PROVENANCE.md.

claims.claim: Gamma is a Mellin evaluation of the exponential carrier and a log-coordinate Fourier transform; for real positive s its normalized carrier has mean and variance s, with log-chart mode at t=s.
claims.hypotheses: Euler integral with Lebesgue measure and the stated logarithmic Jacobian
provenance: Concurrent #634 GG-01 at 8b1673036fa624c3b2e9e43d67bddcbae7f44b86, inspected at publication
claims.hostile_control: The Gram matrix of 1,t under exp(-t)dt is [[1,1],[1,2]]; real monomials are not automatically orthogonal.
claims.next_discriminator: Change the measure or Jacobian and test the transform normalization.

claims.claim: Gamma uniquely normalizes positive continuous homogeneous causal-volume kernels under depth convolution and a fixed unit kernel.
claims.domain: Positive real depths; t>0; ordered finite simplices at integer depth
claims.hypotheses: Homogeneous kernels c(alpha)t^(alpha-1), positive continuous c, convolution law, c(1)=1
claims.quantifiers: All alpha,beta>0 and every finite positive integer simplex dimension
claims.hostile_control: Different unit kernels or dropping homogeneity remove this uniqueness conclusion.
claims.next_discriminator: Mutate the unit law or normalization and replay the Beta convolution.

claims.claim: Tempered fractional integration equals exponential conjugation of a rooted fractional integral.
claims.domain: L1[a,b] on a finite causal interval; alpha>0; lambda>=0
claims.hypotheses: Almost-everywhere operators and bounded finite-interval exponential multipliers
claims.quantifiers: Every admissible input f and depth pair
claims.hostile_control: Real positive rate is not unitary; whole-half-line positive exponential multiplication is unbounded. Wrong signs and powers fail audit holdouts.
claims.next_discriminator: Replay a nonconstant input at a nonzero basepoint; require domains for any global extension.

claims.proof_status: CLASSICAL / INHERITED WITH EXPLICIT TAIL BOUND
claims.claim: Gamma averaging of Poissonized source evolution gives (2I-K)^(-alpha), a depth semigroup with certified finite-prefix error.
claims.hypotheses: Specified source-step operator and declared time orientation
claims.quantifiers: All positive depths and nonnegative truncation cutoffs
claims.hostile_control: Forward source evolution averages future observables; retarded delay is a different interpretation. Algebraic invertibility alone does not imply positive-series convergence.
claims.next_discriminator: Check the positive six-cycle truncation errors against the exact tail majorant.

claims.claim: The authenticated Oily unit PGF has a retained-source positive fractional-depth semigroup with explicit bounded generator.
claims.domain: x in [0,1], positive depth; Banach contraction K; strongly measurable bounded fields
claims.hypotheses: Original u,v,R,p_j; fractional depths declared extension; x=1 uses conditional limit
claims.quantifiers: Every fixed x and all positive depth pairs
claims.hostile_control: Only depth one is the original normalized grade law; endpoint has two loops and raw R(1)=0.
claims.next_discriminator: Compare to inherited SourceGeometry; mutate a loop or omit the endpoint factor two.

claims.claim: Marginalizing the authentic shared source breaks depth composition; the simplest defect is (7pi-20)/(5pi^2)>0.
claims.hypotheses: Same retained source across both layers; positive nondegenerate source measure
claims.quantifiers: All declared depths and z; exact z=0 alpha=beta=1 specialization
claims.hostile_control: Fixed x and z=1 give zero; separately averaging describes source redraw. General operator defect is not asserted PSD.
claims.next_discriminator: Compare joint two-layer grades with fixed-source and redraw controls.

claims.proof_status: SOURCE-SPECIFIC PAPER PROOF / INHERITED RANK MECHANISM
claims.claim: Every shifted Hankel matrix of m_n=E[a_X^n] is positive definite; no finite autonomous linear depth realization exists.
claims.hypotheses: a_x strictly monotone on an interval, positive source density, a_x>0
claims.quantifiers: All finite Hankel sizes and shifts; eventual recurrences also excluded
claims.hostile_control: Fixed-x control has rank one. Finite nonlinear or programmable descriptions are not excluded.
claims.next_discriminator: Test any proposed finite linear realization above its claimed state dimension.

claims.claim: m_n=(c_n/2)m_1 with rational computable c_n and no amplification of absolute scalar-input error.
claims.domain: Every integer n>=1 under the authenticated source family
claims.hypotheses: Known a_x polynomial and source normalization; exact coefficient arithmetic
claims.quantifiers: All integer depths; implementation explicitly caps n<=16
claims.hostile_control: One measured moment does not authenticate the source class; exact operation count is not constant bit cost.
claims.next_discriminator: Use a finite-moment-matched alternate source, or audit bit cost at larger depths.

claims.claim: Raw source descent, shape-one descent, and descent of the complete Gamma family are equivalent.
claims.domain: Finite-dimensional K with spectrum in closed unit disk; linear P
claims.hypotheses: Global report kernel, not one observed trajectory; analytic functional calculus
claims.quantifiers: Every K,P in the declared domain
claims.hostile_control: Implementation merely requires nonsingular 2I-K for integer algebra and does not infer spectral hypotheses.
claims.next_discriminator: Replay Q or the kernel/collision witness against the supplied matrices.

claims.claim: Single-shape descent agrees with source descent for 0<alpha<6; order six can alias the source.
claims.domain: Finite-dimensional complex K with spectrum in closed unit disk; linear P
claims.hypotheses: Principal branch and full Jordan interpolation, not just eigenvalue comparison
claims.quantifiers: All depths in the open interval; exact positive six-cycle counterexample at six
claims.hostile_control: Positive six-cycle P F6=-P/27, but states1,5 have equal current report and next reports -1/2,1. A mean is not the full report distribution.
claims.next_discriminator: Test an order below six, or add a phase-separating report coordinate.

claims.claim: Admitted Gamma orders are {0}, d*N0, or all nonnegative reals; discrete d>=6.
claims.hypotheses: Invertibility, finite-dimensional invariant kernel implies onto, continuity
claims.quantifiers: Every linear report; six-cycle realizes d=6
claims.hostile_control: Infinite-dimensional invariant subspaces need not be onto; arbitrary integer source horizon monoids are a different theorem.
claims.next_discriminator: An infinite-dimensional extension requires a new inverse-invariance argument.

claims.claim: Every source-marginalized Gamma depth family is a semigroup.
claims.domain: The specific authentic Oily source suffices to refute the universal claim
claims.hostile_control: Nonzero exact defect (7pi-20)/(5pi^2); certified rational positive interval.
claims.next_discriminator: Repair by retaining x or by declaring independent redraw as a changed process.

claims.claim: A predictable Gamma-averaged observable entails a predictable next SUCC report.
claims.domain: Positive six-cycle with the specified first-harmonic report
claims.hypotheses: Gamma order6; globally equal current reports
claims.next_discriminator: Repair by choosing the actual future target and proving its separate descent.

claims.claim: Infinite Hankel rank rules out every finite program predicting the sequence.
claims.quantifiers: A single finite algorithm works for every finite n
claims.hostile_control: Rational coefficient c_n/2 predicts all depths stably despite full Hankel rank.
claims.next_discriminator: Restrict the lower bound to fixed finite autonomous linear realizations.

claims.claim: The constructed fractional-depth law is the actually received physical or selected BBP carry observation channel.
claims.domain: Physical or arithmetic-time observation claims beyond the declared auxiliary model
claims.hypotheses: Requires an authenticated source/probe map and target-specific intertwining with costs/errors
claims.hostile_control: Positive source packets, matching marginals, and Gamma formulas alone do not identify the signed selected orbit.
claims.next_discriminator: Specify actual reports and source-labelled probes, then prove or falsify the intertwiner.
